title: Request Batch Data Access
description: Request access to batch data sources via Delta Sharing

elements.name: sla_info
elements.html:
SLA:

Batch data access requests are typically processed within 7-10 business days due to data owner approval requirements. Large data volume requests (>100 GB) require additional infrastructure review and may take up to 14 business days. One-time exports are usually faster than recurring access.

elements.name: important_notes
elements.html:
Important Notes:
  • Batch data access uses Delta Sharing - make sure your use case requires batch export, not real-time queries
  • Specify the exact data source name - data owners need to approve each source
  • Large data volumes may require special handling - be accurate about expected size
  • Recurring access (daily/weekly) requires ongoing monitoring - justify the frequency
  • Data exports are subject to retention policies - check with data owners about data retention requirements
  • One-time exports are often faster to approve than recurring access
  • Make sure you have the necessary storage space in your destination system
